shadow: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 3-column x 4-row sprite sheet for one original SHADOW enemy in a top-down JRPG field. Reference image 1 is existing enemy identity: small black hooded wraith, cyan glowing eyes, charcoal ragged cloak, thin claw hands, no weapon. Reference image 2 is only the desired modern detailed pixel-art SD field style and proportions. Match that style, crisp pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, 2.5 heads tall, detailed yet clear at native 64x64. Twelve equally sized poses on a perfectly regular 3x4 grid, transparent background, no labels or dividers. Rows strictly front facing down, left profile facing left, right profile facing right, back facing up. Columns standing neutral, left step, right step. All three poses in each row must face exactly the same direction. Subtle alternating cloak hem and arm motion for gliding movement, identical head size/body scale and baseline across all 12 frames, centered within their cells, large transparent gutters between cells. No shadows under feet, no ground, no extra objects. Keep cyan eyes understated, silhouette readable in lamplight. The whole image should have 3:4 aspect ratio.
boss: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for a single BOSS field sprite in a modern high-resolution pixel-art SD top-down JRPG. Reference is existing armored shadow enemy identity. Preserve hood, black empty face, small cyan eyes, large dark steel pauldrons and gauntlets with subtle cyan cracks, ragged charcoal cloak. Make an imposing armored shadow leader with a readable broad silhouette but SD proportions about 2.5 heads tall. 3 columns x 4 rows equally sized and aligned, no text, no borders, no environment, no floor or cast shadows. Rows front/down, left profile facing left, right profile facing right, back/up. Columns idle, glide stride A, glide stride B. Lock head size and body scale across all frames. All poses centered with generous transparent gutters. Crisp modern detailed pixel clusters intended for 64x64 native cells, compatible with the hero's detailed SD field sprites; no blur or anti-aliased painterly brushwork. Whole canvas portrait 3:4 aspect ratio. Armor is silver charcoal with cyan seams, no added weapons or crown.
